calls.video_title: 4 Stocks You’ll Wish You Bought on This Dip (One Is Down Over 50%)
calls.price_at_call: under $15 (stated); traded as high as ~$33 in the last ~18 months
calls.thesis: BUY, speculative / small position only (first tracked for MarketBeat; guest Alec Green) — Summit Therapeutics (captions say 'Summit Technologies') is a pre-revenue China-based biotech whose lung-cancer drug beat expectations in Chinese tests; FDA decision expected mid-November (~14-15 Nov) on US use vs Merck's Keytruda, plus Q4 China trial results; he suggests a small position and even November calls, taking at least half off on a big pop.
calls.bull_case: FDA approval could produce a big spike / 'moonshot'; Baker Brothers hold a large position.
calls.bear_case: Pre-revenue and highly volatile; if FDA approval fails, the thesis and any November calls fail with it.
